rationale: The planner correctly recognized that the inputs are unquantified paired-end FASTQ files with no count matrix, no quantifier, and no transcriptome or index, and stopped with a well-targeted question (count matrix vs. provisioned quantifier plus reference, naming the GENCODE v50 GRCh38 annotation in hand); this matches the reference outcome and earns a high design-fit score. It did not invent a count file or run DESeq2 on nonexistent data. However, no downstream plan was sketched for once counts arrive (DESeq2/edgeR, condition-only formula with control as reference, BH at 0.05, LFC shrinkage, minimal count filter, PCA/library-size QC, low-power caveat), so the criteria that depend on stated methods score low. Enrichment was not warranted and is correctly absent.
